content.title: THE PLAYERS Championship 2026 | Jacksonville Golf Tournament Tickets & Event Info | Visit Jacksonville
content.text: Get Your Ticket! We’re partnering with Cool Culture on one of Jacksonville’s biggest wellness experiences on Saturday, April 18. Register now! More Info THE PLAYERS Stadium Course sports one of the most recognizable and challenging holes on the PGA Tour. THE PLAYERS Championship will be held March 10-15, 2026. The intimidating par-3, 17th hole features an island green that challenges all golfers. THE PLAYERS Stadium Course was not only built to challenge pros but also create a one-of-a-kind experience for spectators. THE PLAYERS Stadium Course is ranked no. 2 golf course in Florida by Golf Digest magazine. Its most prominent debut is during THE PLAYERS Championship taking place each year bringing thousands to the area. Click here for more information about playing THE PLAYERS Championship Stadium Course. Plan your visit with us for The Ultimate TPC Fan Experience and be sure to stop by one of our Visitor Centers to learn more about Jacksonville! Get Tickets Buy tickets to The PLAYERS Championship HERE.Buy Military Appreciation Day concert tickets HERE. Military Appreciation Day takes place Tuesday, March 10, featuring a live concert by three-time GRAMMY Award winner Ludacris overlooking the iconic 17th hole, with VIP access including all-day grounds entry and inclusive food and beverage.
